title: ひなたのケーキ作りとその周囲の出来事
lead: ひなたは、誰かが早く来たことに気づき、何かを始める準備をしていた。

articleBodyHtml:
準備をしていたひなた

ひなたは、誰かが早く来たことに気づき、何かを始める準備をしていた。

ケーキ作りの始まり

ひなたは、誰かに付き合ってもらうことを提案し、ケーキ作りを始める。

砂糖の量についての疑問

ひなたは、砂糖の量を尋ね、相手を過小評価しているのではないかと疑う。

視線に気づいたひなた

ひなたは、相手の視線に気づき、なぜそう見ているのか尋ねる。

ケーキが早く焼ける理由

ひなたは、ケーキが早く焼ける理由を尋ねる。

秘密を明かさないひなた

ひなたは、ケーキが早く焼ける秘密を明かさず、誕生日を一緒に過ごすことを楽しみにしている。

秘密を守ってもらうお願い

ひなたは、秘密を他の人に話さないように頼み、誰かと一緒にいるのが嬉しいと伝える。

プレゼントは不要

ひなたは、プレゼントは不要だと伝え、みんなで集まるのが嬉しいと伝える。

timeline.text: Hmm? Well, aren't you early. I was just about to get started.
I was just looking through this recipe book you lent me.
The way you were talking, I thought this would be some kind of challenge, but I don't think I need your help after all.
Oh, but you're welcome to keep me company. The more the merrier, or so they say.
I'm sure the others will be here soon anyway.
Okay. Room temperature egg. I'll put it in the microwave for a minute or so. Should be fine.
One cup of sugar? Are they underestimating me?
Heh. This is all it takes. Really is just a piece of cake, huh?
What? Why are you looking at me like that?
Into the oven now?
Oh, you poured me a drink. How timely. I was just getting thirsty.
We can chat while we wait. It should be done in about... 10 minutes.
How am I baking it faster?
That's a trade secret.
I know you asked me earlier why I wanted to bake the cake myself, even though it's my birthday.
Are you still curious?
Well, this is going to be the first birthday I get to spend with everyone.
They offered to buy me one, but...
Since they deserve the very best, it's only natural that I make it myself.
Don't, uh, tell them that, though. That's... between us, okay?
A gift? I don't need anything. It'll be nice to just have everyone in one spot for a while.
Besides, the praise I'm expecting for this cake is gift enough.
Ah-ha! Time for cake-
Oh, wait. Why is it smoking? It's so burnt!
